1.consolidated_definition: Trabaja en la romana. Se encarga de pesar la caña y el vehículo que transporta. También romanero.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Works on the sugarcane harvest. Responsible for weighing the cane and the vehicle that transports it. Also known as a sugarcane weigher or a ronero (a person who works in the sugar industry).
